etup:

Place the water container close to the plant.

For a first-time Blumat Classic setup:

Fill the ceramic cone and tubing fully with water.
Place the water container close to the plant.
Insert the cone firmly into the soil so it has good contact.
Keep the reservoir positioned correctly so water can siphon properly.
Let it regulate watering based on the soil moisture.
Blumat Classic does not use an adjustment screw, so the key first-time setup points are priming the cone and tubing, good soil contact, and correct reservoir position.
